name: @agimon-ai/po-mcp-proxy
stderr:
Usage: po-mcp-proxy [options] [command]

MCP proxy server package

Options:
  -V, --version                            output the version number
  -h, --help                               display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]                           Initialize MCP configuration file
  mcp-serve [options]                      Start MCP server with specified transport or prestart the HTTP runtime in the background
  search-tools [options]                   Search proxied MCP tools by capability or server
  describe-tools [options] <toolNames...>  Describe specific MCP tools
  use-tool [options] <toolName>            Execute an MCP tool with arguments
  list-resources [options]                 List all available resources from connected MCP servers
  read-resource [options] <uri>            Read a resource by URI from a connected MCP server
  list-prompts [options]                   List all available prompts from connected MCP servers
  get-prompt [options] <promptName>        Get a prompt by name from a connected MCP server
  prefetch [options]                       Pre-download packages used by MCP servers (npx, pnpx, uvx, uv)
  stop [options]                           Stop a running HTTP mcp-proxy server
  cleanup [options]                        Reap orphaned/stale mcp-proxy HTTP runtimes and their leftover state files
  help [command]                           display help for command
